title: What Should a Software Team Spend on Agents? Simulation-Based Cost Optimization of Mixed AI-Human Teams
abstract: arXiv:2610.20394v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context: AI agents are rapidly adopted in software development, but their token costs are rising and it is unclear how much a team should spend on agents, and on which tasks.   Objective: We determine how teams should divide spending between human developers and AI agents to deliver the features a project demands at the lowest total cost.   Method: We model mixed teams of human developers and AI agents with eight specialized roles as a discrete-time stochastic process covering bug injection and detection, technical debt, human supervision of agents, and release cycles with feature freezes. Using Monte Carlo simulation and evolutionary search, we determine cost-optimal teams for 432 scenarios varying developer capability, project velocity, debt dynamics, agent capability and price, and bug costs, and compare them with a human-only baseline. translated_title: 软件团队应该在智能体上花费多少？基于仿真的AI与人类混合团队成本优化
translated_abstract: 背景：AI智能体正在软件开发中被快速采用，但其token成本不断上升，目前尚不清楚团队应该在智能体上花费多少，以及应该在哪些任务上花费。目标：我们确定团队应如何在人类开发者和AI智能体之间分配支出，以最低的总成本交付项目所需的功能。方法：我们将由人类开发者和八种专业角色AI智能体组成的混合团队建模为一个离散时间随机过程，涵盖缺陷注入与检测、技术债务、人类对智能体的监督，以及带有功能冻结的发布周期。通过蒙特卡洛模拟和进化搜索，我们针对432种场景（涵盖开发者能力、项目速度、债务动态、智能体能力与价格以及缺陷成本等因素）确定了成本最优的团队配置，并将其与纯人类团队基线进行比较。结果：逃逸缺陷是主要的成本驱动因素，61%的智能体预算用于查找缺陷……
tldr: 该论文通过蒙特卡洛模拟和进化搜索对432种场景进行建模，研究了软件团队在人类开发者与AI智能体之间的最优支出分配策略，发现逃逸缺陷是主要成本驱动因素，且61%的智能体预算应用于查找缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper uses Monte Carlo simulation and evolutionary search across 432 scenarios to determine the cost-optimal allocation of spending between human developers and AI agents, finding that escaped bugs are the dominant cost driver and 61% of the agent budget should go toward finding bugs.
